description: List a plugin's authentication versions (filter=getAuthDetails, identifier=<pluginId>) to find an authid. Responses include decrypted client secrets: never show them to the user.

filter.description: Required. getAuthDetails (all of a plugin's auth versions) or updateAuthDetails (one auth version by rowid). e.g. getAuthDetails

identifier.description: Required. Plugin id for getAuthDetails; auth version rowid for updateAuthDetails

name: list_auth_versions
